label: Marketing campaign brief
description: Propose a structured marketing campaign brief (goal, audience, offer, channels, KPIs, timeline) for downstream compose and connector steps
propose_guide: Use early when NL asks to plan a campaign, launch, promo, or go-to-market brief. Emit structured fields (goal, audience, offer, primary_channels, kpis, timeline, constraints) as Internal content — do not post or email yet. Follow with marketing/channel-mix if channels are unclear, then compose/ab copy, then external connectors (linkedin/publish, mailchimp/campaign, wordpress/post, etc.) under human gates. Never invent Vault credentials or skip approval on write-external steps.
